title: Unified SDK Adoption Index and Cycle Reporting
creator: Priya Khatri
description: Goal: create a repeatable, cross-cycle reporting pipeline and scorecard (the 'SDK Adoption Index') that combines SDK telemetry, docs engagement, quickstart conversion, and support signals so PMs and leadership can reliably track DevX initiatives and tie improvements to OKRs. Deliverables: (1) adoption index definition and weightings, (2) a scheduled data pipeline and Looker/Metabase dashboard, (3) a retrospective + playbook template for each cycle, and (4) an automation to surface regressions in adoption metrics after SDK or docs releases. Success criteria: index implemented and publishing weekly updates, >15% lift in quickstart-to-first-API-call conversion for at least one SDK by end of cycle, and runbook adopted by two product squads for rollout. Risks: telemetry gaps across SDKs, different event semantics across languages, and potential privacy constraints for user-level tracking. Mitigations: map canonical events, fall back to aggregate signals, and check with legal on PII filters. Stakeholders: DevX PMs, SDK engineers, Docs, DX Solutions, Analytics infra.
